name: Intel Embree
scope: CPU library profile (the BVH of the product CPU device on every RID): the SYCL GPU kernels and their Level Zero headers, tutorials, tests, the superbuild, documentation, man pages, packaging scripts and the notice inventories of the binary releases are excluded (see the component exclusions in dependency-imports.json).
reference: Licence check of the release source archive: verdict PASS with build conditions (docs/RELEASE-LICENSE-PLAN.md, "Embree build conditions"). Every imported file is Apache-2.0 except common/simd/arm/sse2neon.h (MIT, compiled on ARM64 only); the proprietary texts of the release (oneAPI DPC++ EULA notices, Visual C++ redistributables) concern the binary releases and are not imported.
buildConditions: EMBREE_SYCL_SUPPORT OFF, EMBREE_ISPC_SUPPORT OFF, EMBREE_TUTORIALS OFF on every RID
EMBREE_TASKING_SYSTEM TBB with the reviewed third_party/deps/tbb snapshot (no second TBB)
Static library (EMBREE_STATIC_LIB ON) linked into the product CPU device; EMBREE_ZIP_MODE OFF
Ship LICENSE.txt (Apache-2.0) and the sse2neon MIT notice in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt
